title: TAP-Block for perioperative pain management after hernia repair surgery. A retrospective monocentric Study in a German primary care hospital.
summary: We intend to study the success and applicability of the method "TAP-Block" as a pain therapie method after groin hernia surgery.

interventions.name: A control group of hernia repair patients (TEP/TAPP/Lichetenstein) from the year 2023 before the TAP-Block method was introduced in our center should be compared to a test group from the year 2024 after introducing the method.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Elektive hernia repair TEP/TAPP/Lichtenstein
unilateral
without other additional surgical interventions
reapir under general anesthesia
Exclusion criteria:
Allergies to one or more analgetics
Patient on a chronic opioid therapy
Spinal anesthesia
Adminstration of analgetics not included in our SOP
Surgical complications in PACU.
